scope: Existing staging testnet APAC Gateway only. One SDK throughout. Twelve other deployment versions stayed fixed. All thirteen original versions were verified after restoration and tenant reactivation. No new resource, migration, production deployment or package publication.
method: Sequential baseline/candidate with three fresh NEAR-only wallets and twenty-one verified signatures per arm. Matching Gateway bundles differ only in finalize operation-read consolidation and extraction of unchanged transactional revalidation.

comparisonScope.returnBaseline: omitted after a second activation window was blocked by unfinished US registration state
comparisonScope.candidateActivationFailure: readiness_invalid; retried successfully after the earlier registration expired
comparisonScope.latencyInterpretation: Finalize median decreased; whole SDK signing did not improve consistently. No causal whole-flow speedup claim.

candidateActivationPause.state: one unfinished registration in US before the benchmark; retried after normal expiry

structuralD1Reduction.measurementKind: Verified source call graph; hosted D1 counters unavailable

coverage: transaction and message signing across reload and exhausted budget
retired session denied and fresh unlock succeeds
missing and tampered receipt denied; discarded finalize reply replayed at zero budget; retired replay denied
e2e.fixtureRepair: valid_test_needs_update: use the SQLite adapter all() method exposed by the harness type; the final E2E and type check passed

limitations: Three candidate wallets. The return-baseline arm was omitted after a second registration-readiness block. Sequential timing samples do not establish a percentile or guaranteed whole-flow saving.
SDK signing includes automated user confirmation, nonce/RPC work and MPC. It excludes blockchain submission and confirmation.
elapsedToVerifiedMs also includes browser interaction and independent signature verification. Registration includes funding and provisioning. Unlock includes the unlock lifecycle.
HTTP counts cover browser requests. D1 and Gateway-to-Console counters remain unavailable; null does not mean zero. Browser-to-Console requests were zero.
One less D1 batch is established by the implementation call graph, not hosted request counters. Fresh transactional authorization still reads and revalidates the operation.
This change does not optimize Yao setup, DO initialization, placement or cryptography. Registration setup variation is not an optimization result.
The independent ECDSA confirmation timeout recorded in Phase 6R remains outside this NEAR change.

reproduction.build: Public .artifacts/r155b-phase6t/build.py builds baseline and candidate server packages from source.json. The fixed SDK comes from Phase 6S. Frozen private Gateway source imports the selected server package during Wrangler dry-run builds.
reproduction.local: Run passkey.ed25519-yao-local.contract.test.ts with the four scenario names in localVerification.coverage against a fresh local Gateway and the fixed SDK. The committed finalize scenario emits near-finalize-replay.json.
reproduction.hosted: Private .artifacts/r155b-phase6t-hosted/run.py and resume.py guard all thirteen deployment versions around each arm, activates each Gateway version through the staging workflow, restores the original Gateway and activation, and closes tails in finally. finish-restore.py verifies the rollback after an initially stale deployment read and completes tenant activation.
